name: stremio-offline
description: Self-hosted web client for Stremio addons

scripts.build: npm run build -w @stremio-offline/source-selection && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @stremio-offline/source-selection && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && npm run test -w desktop && npm run test:media-client
scripts.test:e2e:docker: npm run build && docker build -t stremio-offline-e2e -f e2e/Dockerfile . && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 stremio-offline-e2e sh -c 'npx playwright test && npx playwright test -c playwright.restricted.config.ts && npx playwright test -c playwright.leadcap.config.ts'
scripts.test:e2e:snapshots: npm run build && docker build -t stremio-offline-e2e -f e2e/Dockerfile . && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 -e LAYOUT_SEED_ONLY=1 stremio-offline-e2e npx playwright test --update-snapshots
